scenes.name: Tideline
scenes.prompt: Create quiet cinematic scenery for a personal desktop workspace featuring original minimalist brutalist architecture in a quiet coastal setting, gentle dawn light, and a muted sea-glass palette. Use subtle atmospheric depth, deliberate negative space, and a calm low-detail center. No people, text, lettering, logos, UI, interface elements, or busy foregrounds.
